tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Returns detailed information about a product. You can provide its exact productId, or productName.

productId.description: The unique ID of the product.

productName.description: A part of the product name or keywords to match (e.g. 'training balls').

tools.name: get_store_promos_and_rules
tools.description: Returns active promotional campaigns, eligibility requirements, and general store rules (e.g., local pickup categories).

tools.name: open_cart
tools.description: Opens the shopping cart modal to review items and proceed to checkout.

tools.name: search_product
tools.description: Search for products based on the query.

query.description: Search term for products (e.g. 'soccer boots', 'running gear').

size.description: Product size. Use 'child' for kids/children, 'adult' for adults.

tools.name: view_product
tools.description: Navigates to the product detail page for a given product. You can provide its exact productId, or productName.

productId.description: The unique ID of the product.

productName.description: A part of the product name or keywords to match (e.g. 'training balls').
